look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson five
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 2, lesson T05, Buy, Sell, Long and Short; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: Two directions
scenes.desc: A fictional BTC price rises and falls; can anyone gain when it falls?

scenes.name: Spot buy and sell
scenes.desc: Spot buying swaps 600 USDT for 0.01 BTC at 60,000; selling at 62,000 returns 620 USDT.

scenes.name: Owning vs a position
scenes.desc: Spot is ownership; a futures contract gives a position with profit and loss but no coins.

scenes.name: Going long
scenes.desc: A long gains when price rises: 0.01 BTC from 60,000 to 61,000 is +10 USDT; to 59,000 is -10 USDT.

scenes.name: Going short
scenes.desc: A short gains when price falls: 0.01 BTC from 60,000 to 59,000 is +10 USDT; to 61,000 is -10 USDT.

scenes.name: One price, two results
scenes.desc: One price path with long and short meters side by side; the results flip when the market reverses.

scenes.name: Spot is not margin
scenes.desc: Spot buy vs futures long with margin: the margin shrinks with losses and can be liquidated; selling is not shorting.

scenes.name: Long, short or wait
scenes.desc: Pick long, short or wait; a set fictional path ends at 59,800: long -2, short +2, wait 0.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause and work it out: a short of 0.02 BTC from 60,000 to 60,500 loses 10 USDT.

scenes.name: Know the risks
scenes.desc: Unlimited short losses, leverage and liquidation, fees and funding, no sure direction.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and one question to check yourself.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T06, Entry, Exit and Profit/Loss.
